jobs.title: Customer and Client Support Specialist
jobs.description: About Us Hozah is a tech-led, award-winning company driving change in the parking industry and reimagining urban mobility. Our mission is simple but powerful: to transform parking into a seamless, automated experience, paving the way for smarter, more sustainable cities. We run camera-based parking for landowners and operators, from hotels and colleges to shopping centres, across England, Scotland and Wales. With recent recognition as PayTech Company of the Year, a place among Deloitte’s Top 50 Fastest Growing Tech Companies in the UK, and significant VC/PE investment, we’re one of the fastest scaling companies in the country. Role Overview We’re looking for a Customer and Client Support Specialist to join our support team in Croydon. You’ll help two groups of people: the drivers who park at our sites, and the landowners and asset managers we work with. Most of the job is email, through Zendesk. This isn’t answering from an FAQ. A good reply means reading the message properly, working out what’s actually being asked, checking the facts across our systems, and writing an answer that solves the problem without creating a new one. Some drivers will be angry, and some will be wrong but loud. We need someone who stays calm, gets it right, and follows up until it’s fixed. It’s a role for a “learn-it-all” who cares about getting small things right, ticket after ticket. Almost everything is teachable in your first couple of months, and there’s plenty of room to grow as the company does. Key Responsibilities Respond to driver and client enquiries by email, clearly, accurately and on time. Investigate each case properly before replying, checking details such as references, tariffs and permit lists. Keep accurate records of every interaction. Work with TechOps, Client Success and other teams on the trickier cases, and chase until they’re resolved. jobs.title: Travel Support Specialist
jobs.description:
Position Overview We are seeking dependable and customer-focused individuals to join our team as a Travel Support Specialist. This remote role focuses on assisting clients with travel-related inquiries, supporting reservation coordination, and ensuring a smooth and positive customer experience throughout the booking process. This is an entry-level opportunity within the travel industry. No prior travel experience is required. Structured onboarding and training are provided. 
 Key Responsibilities Respond to client inquiries regarding travel options, reservations, and itinerary details Assist with coordinating and confirming bookings for hotels, cruises, and vacation packages Review travel information for accuracy, including dates, traveler details, and accommodations Provide timely updates and clear communication before and after travel Maintain organized records of client interactions and reservations Deliver professional and responsive customer support Qualifications Strong written and verbal communication skills Customer-focused mindset with attention to detail Comfortable using online systems and digital platforms Ability to work independently in a remote environment Previous customer service, hospitality, or administrative experience is helpful but not required 
 $35,000 - $65,000 a year 
 What We Offer Structured onboarding and guided training Access to booking tools and travel supplier resources Ongoing professional development opportunities Flexible remote work environment Supportive and collaborative team culture Ideal Candidate This role is well suited for individuals seeking remote customer service opportunities, career changers exploring the travel industry, or professionals with service-oriented backgrounds.
